pay: $17.50 an hour, plus $1.50 an hour for nights, paid weekly

sections.say: Hi, this is {{caller}} from Northline, about the overnight stocker job you applied for at our Dayton store. It takes about five minutes, is now still a good time?
First the shifts, because they decide everything else.

questions.text: We need people Sunday to Wednesday nights, 10pm to 6:30am. Can you work those four nights?
We also have Thursday and Friday nights, same hours. Can you do either of those?
If we offered you the job this week, when could you start?
How would you get here for a 10pm start, and home again at 6:30 in the morning?
Are you authorized to work in the US?

sections.say: The honest picture: it is overnight, on your feet the whole shift, lifting cases up to 40 pounds, and the back room is cold in winter. Pay is $17.50 an hour, plus $1.50 an hour for nights, paid every week.

questions.text: Knowing that, do you still want it?
What would you like to ask me?

sections.say: Good, you're through to an interview.

no.availability: Thanks for being straight with me. Nights are the only shifts we have at Dayton right now, so I can't move you forward for this one. If a day role opens, I'll text you.
no.prerequisite: Thanks. This job needs you to be 18 or older and authorized to work in the US, so I can't move you forward for it today.
no.preview: That's fair, and better to know now than after a week of nights. Thanks for your time, and good luck.

sections.redirect: Our Kettering store is short of weekend day shifts, Saturday and Sunday 7am to 3:30pm, same pay. If those suit you, I can book you there instead, right now.

sections.say: I can do {{slot_1}} or {{slot_2}} at the store, about twenty minutes with {{interviewer}}. Which works?
sections.confirmation: Northline: you're booked for {{slot}} at {{address}}. Ask for {{interviewer}} at the service desk. Reply C to change the time.

voicemail: Hi, it's {{caller}} from Northline about the overnight stocker job at our Dayton store. I'll text you straight after this: reply there, or book a time with the link. Thanks!
follow_up_text: Northline here about the overnight stocker job in Dayton. Sorry we missed you! Book a 5-minute call: {{booking_link}} or reply with a good time. Reply STOP to opt out.

attempts.stop: After the third call with no answer, send the last-chance text and close them as unreachable. No fourth call.

callback: Thanks for calling back. You applied for overnight stocker at Northline in Dayton: do you have five minutes now? Then start at availability.
